description: Freeflow melee combat mod for Minecraft (Fabric 1.21.1)

mods.name: Freeflow Combat
mods.description: Rhythm-based freeflow melee combat: target snapping, combos, counters, evades and takedowns.

releases.notes:
Second beta of Freeflow Combat for **Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric)**.

**Install:** Fabric Loader 0.16+, [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 1.21.1, and this jar (playerAnimator and Cloth Config are bundled). Mod Menu optional. On servers, install on the server and every client.

**New since beta.1**
- **Combat challenge arena:** `/freeflow arena start` builds an arena in the sky and sends four waves (thugs, shields, armed fighters and shooters, then everything plus a ravager). Getting knocked out ends the run instead of killing you; afterwards you're sent back and the arena is removed. Arena enemies drop no loot.
- **Infinite mode:** `/freeflow arena infinite`: endless waves, one more enemy each wave (up to 14), new enemy kinds join as you go, a boss wave every 5th wave, tougher enemies after wave 10.
- **Records:** `/freeflow arena records` shows your best classic time, most infinite waves and the world's top runs (saved with the world).
- Arena quality of life: heal between waves, wave and enemies-left on the action bar, the last stragglers glow if a wave drags on.
- **Enemies keep their distance:** waiting enemies hold a loose ring around you in a fighting stance, side-stepping and spaced apart, and are sent in to attack one at a time instead of piling up. New settings: stand-off distance and enemy spacing.

The arena is for operators and singleplayer world owners by default; a server setting opens it to everyone.

See the README for the full controls table.

mods.name: Freeflow Combat
mods.description: Rhythm-based freeflow melee combat: target snapping, combos, counters, evades and takedowns.

releases.notes:
First release build of Freeflow Combat for **Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric)**. Beta: tested by automated GameTests, a dev client fighting on a dedicated server, and the jar on a production Fabric server; real-controller and multi-person play still need testing.

**Install:** Fabric Loader 0.16+, [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 1.21.1, and this jar (playerAnimator and Cloth Config are bundled). Mod Menu optional. On servers, install on the server and every client.

**Highlights**
- Freeflow fist combat: target snapping, combos and rhythm, counters (blue ! = counter, red ! = roll), rolls/vaults, slide, stun, beatdown, ground and special takedowns
- Enemies take turns (up to 4 attacking), with Arkham-style reactions: falls, throws, get-ups
- Over-the-shoulder combat camera with dynamic framing and cinematic finishers
- Hold Space to run in fights
- PS5 DualSense support with the Arkham Knight button layout
- Settings screen (K or Mod Menu); server settings sync to players; `/freeflow reload`
- Co-op: enemies' stuns/knockdowns are shared between players

See the README for the full controls table.
